communications.subject: Cancellation Request
communications.body:
Hi,

I would like to cancel my subscription with Streaming Service. Please confirm cancellation and ensure I will not be charged again.

Thank you,
Evelyn R. Hayes

communications.subject: RE: Cancellation Request
communications.body:
Hi Evelyn,

Your cancellation request has been received and processed. Your service will remain active until the end of your current billing period. You will not be charged after that date.

Customer Support
Streaming Service

communications.subject: Charge inquiry - TXN-970960742
communications.body:
Hi,

I noticed a charge of $99.99 on my statement from Streaming Service. I would like to understand this charge and request a resolution.

Regards,
Evelyn R. Hayes

communications.subject: RE: Charge inquiry - TXN-970960742
communications.body: Cardholder contacted 'Streaming Service' customer support on 2026-02-12. Merchant acknowledged cancellation but claimed a 'system glitch' for the charge. Offered a refund but stated a processing time of 'up to 30 business days'. Cardholder found this timeframe unacceptable.
